newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa details capitalisation shr award terms.
newsitem.headline: Absa details capitalisation shr award terms.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) said on Monday that shareholders had to be registered in the firm's books on June 13 to be eligible for a capitalisation share award.

Shareholders will be entitled to new shares in the ratio that 45.0 cents bears to the issue price, being the average closing price of Absa shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange for the four days ending July 10, discounted by a factor of five percent.
However, this was subject to a minimum issue price of 2,632 cents a share being the closing price of Absa shares on June 6, discounted by a factor of 10 percent.
Shareholders can instead elect to receive the 45.0 cents cash dividend.
